A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with matching authors, architecture and experimental structure. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-E support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original NVI and Café evaluations, component ablations, robustness experiments and qualitative predictions, including supplementary results in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original NVI and Café evaluations, ablations, robustness experiments and qualitative predictions in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 revises the specified association loss: Eq. (6) replaces group-dependent individual sets J_i and normalization |I||J_i| with a common set J and |I||J|. This is a localized revision of the written objective; architecture and inference remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish an implementation change or retraining.

E1.justification: Both versions already evaluate NVI fine-grained interaction detection and Café group activity detection, including Café's view and place splits. Café's addition to the abstract and conclusion does not introduce new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Both retain m-QPIC, m-CDN, m-GEN-VLKT and NVI-DEHR on NVI; Joint, JRDB-base, HGC and Café-base on Café; and the same LLaVA, LLaVA-LoRA and CLIP-based comparisons. Appendix comparisons also retain NVI-DEHR.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, metrics, model sizes, training schedules and evaluation procedures are retained. Specifying 'Group IoU' clarifies the existing Café metric terminology. The newly supplied LoRA learning rate documents an existing experiment rather than establishing a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The component/loss ablations, part/query-count studies, pose perturbations, loss-weight sensitivity, NMS-threshold analysis and class-wise comparisons retain the same evidence in Tables 4-8 and S2-S6. The qualitative case sets are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. No statistical uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and displayed qualitative predictions are unchanged, including NVI test AR of 78.52. However, Section 4.4 removes the explicit finding of incorrect individual-box predictions in Fig. 3(c), describing severe overlap and successful hug recognition instead. This is a limited change in reported qualitative findings.

T1.justification: Eq. (6) changes the association-loss summation domain and normalization from group-specific J_i to a common individual set J, also explicitly indexing groups by i in I. This is a limited mathematical correction rather than merely equivalent typography; no new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract now explicitly claims generalizability to group activity understanding through Café, and the introduction and conclusion extend their evaluation summaries from NVI to NVI and Café. These broader summary claims draw on Table 2 and discussion already present in v1; the methodological contributions are retained.

C2.justification: Appendix C drops the qualification 'moderate' from its interpretation of robustness to keypoint localization errors. Section 4.4 also reframes Fig. 3(c) without explicitly acknowledging localization errors. The main limitation concerning dependence on a pretrained pose estimator and predefined keypoints remains unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 supplies the previously missing LLaVA-LoRA learning rate, 1e-4, for the existing 15,000-step Adam training procedure. Hardware, Table S1 hyperparameters and code-source information otherwise remain substantively unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds the Kingma and Ba Adam reference. Section 2.2 also revises its description of Wan et al., changing pose-based confidence prediction to focusing on relevant body parts. The broader research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized grammatical and terminology corrections throughout, reorders two contribution bullets, clarifies representative-individual selection, and replaces 'part size' with 'number of parts.' The section organization and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 2 is widened and its caption expanded; figure labels and captions receive small edits, including Fig. 3's enhancer heading and gaze-following label. The same tables, diagrams, attention maps and prediction panels remain in corresponding locations.

improvement.justification: Supplying the missing LoRA learning rate, correcting the association-loss expression and improving terminology provide modest reproducibility and readability gains. The summaries also better reflect the existing Café evaluation. These benefits outweigh the limited loss of qualification in the robustness and localization-error discussion; the experimental evidence itself is unchanged.
